optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Wealth Services Platform

professionalSummary.text: Maintains the model evaluation harness and labelled adviser-review set, reducing false-alert rates through data-driven threshold recalibration.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the evaluation harness (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner) and the labelled review set of adviser-confirmed alerts, adding 1,200 newly labelled alerts over the year. The false-alert rate seen by advisers fell from 31 percent in Q1 to 18 percent in Q4 after the threshold recalibration I proposed was adopted in version 3.2, as measured on the labelled review set and reported against the documented Q1 baseline of 31 percent.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran pre-release evaluations for four model versions, publishing reports to model team and adviser operations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the four model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report to the model team and adviser operations.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented evaluation assumptions, limitations, and hand-over conditions for each model version.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the evaluation notes for each version, listing the review-set composition, the known limitation that alerts on newly onboarded portfolios were under-represented, and the hand-over items for the next evaluation.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Quarterly false-alert report and evaluation notes for version 3.2, with batch runner job identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the quarterly false-alert report (rate per quarter, baseline line, version 3.2 marker) and the evaluation notes for version 3.2, with the batch runner's job identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Python (evaluation harness maintenance), batch runner scheduling, false-alert rate analysis, evaluation report publishing.
skills.witness: Maintained the evaluation harness (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner) and the labelled review set of adviser-confirmed alerts, adding 1,200 newly labelled alerts over the year. Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the four model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report to the model team and adviser operations.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish direct evidence for all requirements through the candidate's CV and work samples, with additional confirmation from a reference call. However, the materials do not establish the candidate's coordination with adviser operations beyond confirming alert-volume impact, nor do they establish the candidate's responsibility boundaries in release decisions.

decisionBoundary.statement: All requirements are supported or partially supported, but coordination with adviser operations and responsibility boundaries require human verification.
